regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, keywords, and graphical-free article header
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate copper-catalyzed three-component claim. The abstract contains no experiment-specific row, quantity, or yield beyond a generic excellent-yield/scale-up statement.

regions.region: page 1 introduction, allene and phosphorothioate context
regions.finding: The natural-product/building-block discussion is context. It introduces the cited propargylic-alcohol route and states its alkyl-substrate failure/trace trisubstituted limitation; these facts are assigned to the prior-work Scheme 1a record on page 2 rather than current experiments.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right propargylic cyclic carbonate discussion
regions.finding: The paragraph introduces copper allenylidene/cationic intermediates and cited prior chemistry continued in Scheme 1b on page 2. Proposed intermediates and literature context are not treated as current-paper preparations.

unresolved: Page 1 contains no experiment-specific procedure or outcome row.
No workspace Supporting Information association is established.

regions.finding: Biologically active allene and organothiophosphate structures are contextual examples, not reaction experiments of this article; no records were fabricated for their syntheses.

Separated cited propargylic-alcohol work, cited cyclic-carbonate thiolation/phosphonylation branches, and the current generic three-component concept. Generic/proposed intermediates I/II are not isolated experiments.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 header, ligand drawings, entries 1–16, and footnotes a–b
regions.finding: Recorded all 16 optimization rows independently with row catalyst/ligand/base/solvent/yield, qualitative trace values, and the entry-16 scale/loading/time/atmosphere overrides. Footnote reagents and quantities are participants/amounts.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right optimization narrative and Scheme 2 introduction
regions.finding: Mapped the prose to the Table 1 rows and the Scheme 2 scope records on page 3 without creating narrative duplicates. The NOESY statement is characterization of 3aa, not another preparation.

unresolved: Table 1 omits workup, purification, isolated product masses, and yield bases.
Generic prior/current scheme substituents and complex ligand structures remain source-labeled where safe encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 2 product grid and caption
regions.finding: Recorded 23 independent two-component scope arrows 3ba–3xa with shared 1b–1x/2a/Cu/L6/DABCO/toluene/room-temperature/4 h/air conditions, row yields, and the superscript-a 3xa catalyst/ligand/base override.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Scheme 2 discussion and initial three-component attempt
regions.finding: The Scheme 2 prose maps to the 23 row records. Separately recorded the 1a 0.11 mmol/2b 0.10 mmol/S8 0.10 mmol initial attempt giving 3aa in 60% with starting material remaining.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Scheme 3 product grid, caption, and optimization prose
regions.finding: Recorded 12 independent three-component scope arrows with shared 1/2b/S8/Cu/L6/DABCO/toluene/room-temperature/4 h/air conditions. The displayed 3aa 86% row is linked to the main-text 1.3:1:1 optimum; no unassociated Table S1-only detail was imported.

regions.region: page 3 center/lower-right Scheme 4a–d and application prose
regions.finding: Recorded two separate gram-scale 3aa preparations, the 3aa esterification to 5aaa, and the 3aa/biphenyl-boronic-acid cross-coupling to 5aab. Scheme/prose gram-scale yield conflicts are retained as 71% versus 76% and 75% versus 80%.

Scheme 4a/4b yield conflicts remain unresolved; several Scheme 4 absolute charges, volumes, and reaction times are missing.
Complex compact scope/application structures remain source-labeled and machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left completion of Scheme 4d discussion
regions.finding: The sentence completes the existing 3aa/4b palladium cross-coupling to trans-1,3-diene 5aab in 38% isolated yield; it is merged with the page-3 arrow rather than duplicated.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 5 and mechanism discussion
regions.finding: Classified copper catalyst A and intermediates B–F as a plausible mechanism, not isolated preparations. The proposed sequence is retained as one mechanism record with no experiment yield assigned.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left conclusion, declarations, acknowledgment, and Supporting materials statement
regions.finding: Administrative/conclusion text adds no experiment. The online Supporting Information statement does not establish a workspace SI association, so no SI-only procedure or characterization was imported.

regions.region: page 4 right-column references 3–70 and lower-left references 1–2
regions.finding: Bibliography/prior-literature citations only; external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.
